description: Implementation of Widevine DRM system integration for Starboard, including session management, key status handling, decryption, and communication with Widevine CDM.

classes.name: WidevineClock
classes.description: Implements a clock interface for Widevine CDM, providing current time in milliseconds.

classes.name: Registry
classes.description: Singleton registry to keep track of active DRM systems.

classes.name: DrmSystemWidevine
classes.description: Main class implementing Widevine DRM system, managing sessions, keys, decryption, and communication with Widevine CDM.

methods.name: EnsureWidevineCdmIsInitialized
methods.description: Initializes Widevine CDM with provided company and model info, ensuring one-time setup.

methods.name: WvdmSessionIdToSbDrmSessionId
methods.description: Converts Widevine session ID to Starboard DRM session ID.

methods.name: SbDrmSessionIdToWvdmSessionId
methods.description: Converts Starboard DRM session ID to Widevine session ID.

methods.name: SendServerCertificateRequest
methods.description: Requests server certificate from Widevine CDM.

methods.name: ProcessServerCertificateResponse
methods.description: Processes server certificate response and sets it in Widevine CDM.

methods.name: GenerateSessionUpdateRequest
methods.description: Creates a new DRM session and generates a license request.

methods.name: UpdateSession
methods.description: Updates a DRM session with a key or server certificate.

methods.name: UpdateServerCertificate
methods.description: Sets a new server certificate in Widevine CDM.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts encrypted media buffers using Widevine CDM.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Handles messages from Widevine CDM, such as license requests.

methods.name: onKeyStatusesChange
methods.description: Handles key status changes from Widevine CDM.

methods.name: onDirectIndividualizationRequest
methods.description: Handles individualization requests from Widevine CDM.
